corrections.reason: The 2nd person masculine singular object suffix on ሰባሕኩ- (John 12:28) is -ከሂ (ሰባሕኩከሂ), clearly printed with the 1st-order ከ.
The Ge'ez preposition + suffix 'in him' (John 12:42) is printed ቦቱ (7th order ቦ with shortened right leg), not በቱ.
In John 13:5 ('he took a towel'), the printed glyph has the shortened right leg of 4th-order ካ (መካፈ ዘለንጽ).
In John 18:20 ('I spoke openly'), the adverbial accusative passive participle is ክሡተ (2nd-order ሡ with the right-side hook clearly visible on the image).
